thread:
Lauren Bishop: Heads up: **Dedicated Throughput Tiers (beta)** are now internally available for quoting + pilots. This is the packaging + SLO framework we’ve been aligning across Product/Runtime/SRE/Infra.

What’s included in beta:
- Tier semantics: **Standard / Performance / Premium**
- Dedicated throughput SLO definition + measurement standard
- Initial shape→tier mapping (region-limited)
- Dashboards + alerting (internal)
- Support escalation + overload mitigation runbook

Docs / links:
- Tier definitions (Confluence): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/PROD/Dedicated+Tier+Definitions
- Throughput measurement standard: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ARCH/Throughput+Measurement+Standard
- Dedicated throughput SLO definition (SLI/SLO/error budget): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SRE/Dedicated+Throughput+SLO
- Dashboards spec + entrypoint: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/OBS/Dedicated+Throughput+SLO+Dashboards
- Overload mitigation runbook: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ONCALL/Dedicated+Overload+Mitigation
- CS/Support escalation playbook: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/CS/Dedicated+Throughput+SLO+Escalation

How to use:
- For **new Dedicated deals**: use the tier definitions + shapes catalog; if a prospect asks for “custom tokens/sec” beyond tiers, please route as an exception request (details below).
- For **existing Dedicated customers**: we can pilot upgrades/migrations per-region based on current shape + workload.

Exception process (for now): ping me + @Jordan Blake with customer/workload + region + model(s) + context length distribution. We’ll loop in SRE/Infra/Runtime for feasibility + pricing uplift.

Please do **not** paste raw tokens/sec numbers in external email yet unless it’s coming from the tier cheat sheet / approved language.

Big thanks to Runtime/SRE/Infra folks who got this over the line. :raised_hands:

—
Talia Benson: Adding: we’ll keep beta tight for ~2 weeks while we validate alerting + reporting. If you want a deal in the pilot set, drop it here (account name + desired region + model family).

Aisha Bello: :white_check_mark: SRE note: alerts are live for internal deployments tagged `dedicated=true` + `tier=*`. If you’re testing in a sandbox and not seeing pages, make sure the deployment labels are set. Also reminder: expected throttling under overload != SLO breach (see the “breach vs throttling” section in the SLO doc).

Sergio Costa: Dashboard is up in Grafana under **“Dedicated / Throughput SLO (beta)”**. Direct link (internal): https://grafana.redwoodinference.net/d/dedicated-throughput-slo
Key panels to look at: effective tokens/sec (rolling window), throttling rate, queue depth, GPU saturation, and prefill vs decode breakdown.

Chloe Martin: For anyone asking where this shows in Console: we’ve got the minimal surface behind a flag (`dedicatedTierStatus`). It shows tier + current throughput vs objective + link-out to export. Not on by default yet.

Vanessa Ortiz: Infra note: **Premium** is currently limited by region due to H100 supply. If Sales is promising “Premium anywhere,” please stop and check first. Current availability is in the shapes catalog doc (kept updated weekly).

Irene Choi: +1. If a deal is region-flexible, we can usually make it work faster. If it’s region-locked + Premium, expect longer lead times.

Jordan Blake: Sales/GTM: we’ll post a one-pager in #sales later today. Until then, please use the tier definitions page + don’t freestyle language around “guarantee”/“SLA” (Legal is particular on this).

Stephanie Nguyen: Enablement session scheduled for Thu 10am PT. We’ll cover qualifying questions (prompt size variance, streaming, concurrency), plus the “what happens when you exceed tier limits” script.

Sofia Ivanova: Runtime clarification (since this is the #1 question): the SLO is measured on **served output tokens**, not requested tokens. Streaming is included; we measure what we actually emit.
If workload pushes beyond the tier envelope, the system may **throttle** (admission control) to protect latency + stability. That behavior is considered “as designed” and is why it’s important to set concurrency assumptions in the proposal.

Noah Patel: Also worth calling out: the measurement standard excludes warmup and scheduled maintenance windows. There’s a section on customer-induced errors too (invalid requests/timeouts caused upstream).

Owen Phillips: Support: we have a new intake template for throughput complaints (required: deployment_id, tier, region, model, time range, example request IDs). If you get a ticket without those, please ask for the missing pieces first — it cuts triage time a lot.

Kira Thompson: I updated the public-facing doc drafts but they’re not published externally yet. Internal canonical source is Confluence pages Lauren linked. If you see inconsistencies, DM me with the section + suggested edit.

RedwoodBot: [automation] Reminder: if you create a Dedicated pilot, tag the deployment with `tier` and `customer_id` labels so SLO reporting buckets correctly.

Rafael Mendes: Q for PM/Runtime: what do we want folks to say when customers ask “is this requests/sec or tokens/sec?”

Lauren Bishop: @Rafael Mendes Answer to use: “We define throughput primarily in **tokens/sec** because request sizes vary; we provide request-level guidance only under documented assumptions (prompt length distribution + max output).” The measurement standard doc has the short wording you can paste internally.

Rafael Mendes: got it. :thumbsup:

Stephanie Nguyen: Another common question we’re seeing: “Can we burst?”

Lauren Bishop: Yes, but it’s tiered + bounded. Standard has minimal burst, Performance more, Premium has the widest burst window + stricter shape requirements. Exact semantics are in the tier definitions; please don’t promise “unlimited burst.”

Vanessa Ortiz: +1 “unlimited burst” is how you get the whole fleet on fire.

Aisha Bello: And it’s how you get paged.

Jordan Blake: For exception asks: please include whether they need a contractual SLA remedy. That changes review path (Legal + SRE signoff).

Talia Benson: I’ll drop the pilot tracking sheet in #product and #sales once it’s cleaned up. For now, reply here w/ accounts and I’ll consolidate.

Lauren Bishop: Thanks all. Keep questions coming in-thread so we can bake the FAQs into the enablement + docs.
